gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves like a broad-nibbed pen, its strokes never curling shut. Noto Traditional Nushu is the friendly anchor, its bowls filling the line while Mystery Quest keeps a bookish, nostalgic display voice up top.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-numans: Numans reads modern and clean, its swollen lowercase spaced far apart. Mystery Quest does its bookish, nostalgic charm through open-jawed curves, while Numans handles the quieter work of reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-open-sans: Mystery Quest leaves every curve open-jawed, ascenders tucked in close. Open Sans is a smooth, contemporary partner whose bulky lowercase never clogs a curve, and that is the pair's real strength.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-oxygen: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest leads with open-jawed curves. Oxygen keeps clean, contemporary curves that never close back on themselves, and that shared openness is what ties the two together.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-pt-sans-caption: Open jaws up top, open bowls below: a bookish, nostalgic look. Mystery Quest hands off to PT Sans Caption, whose big-bodied lowercase and unclosed bowls keep the page feeling contemporary and inviting.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-questrial: Bookish, open-jawed curves in Mystery Quest meet a flat, stencil-cut line in Questrial. And Questrial keeps its strokes at a single weight, which lets the nostalgic heading carry all the personality.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-radio-canada: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest sets the tone with open-jawed curves. Radio Canada draws a steady, pressure-free line with a clear opening at every curve end, so extended reading moves along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big is a monoline sans-serif whose x-height fills the line. Radio Canada Big can sit a size or two below Mystery Quest, since its unswelling curves and open terminals stay legible there.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-readex-pro: Mystery Quest leaves every curved stroke open-jawed, with bookish, nostalgic charm. Readex Pro keeps a steady weight from word to word, with broad terminal gaps and curves that never thin, so extended reading feels smooth.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-roboto: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest wears open jaws on every curved stroke. Roboto, clean and contemporary, would start to rival the heading if the body were made large, given its generous round mouths.
